recommendation_summary: The reply says to replace the row-loading, in-memory count with one PostgreSQL count(*) aggregate. It adds a partial index only if EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows a scan. It rejects Kafka, CQRS and Redis because an event-fed projection is eventually consistent and would break the request-time committed-data requirement. It offers no optional stack additions now and leaves no requirement unmet.
note: The recommendation is a sound bounded fix, but the reply has none of the four labeled record lines, so every label-based predicate fails.
